caption: The drawing features a square composition outlined by a thin gray border, containing geometric and decorative objects. In the upper right corner of the square, there is a grid of sixteen smaller squares, each filled with a repeated red and white floral motif resembling petals radiating from a center point, with the petals rendered in red. The remainder of the background in the square is filled with small, diagonal gray lines forming a crosshatch pattern. Dominating the left and lower portions of the square are two large, red, crescent-shaped objects, each decorated with smaller oval shapes within, positioned end to end and forming a frame around the central area. At the ends of these crescents, there are four symmetrical, fan-shaped structures consisting of three red triangles and two red loops, pointing outward at each corner of the larger square. The drawing is executed in red, gray, and white, with the red objects visually prominent against the pale background.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
